meanings.usage: 指钓鱼这项活动或运动
修饰名词，表示最喜欢的人或事物
过去式为caught，表示抓住或捕获
由lucky加前缀un-构成的反义词
常与of连用，表示代替或转换
英式英语常用，美式英语多用garbage或trash
作动词时表示浪费，作名词时表示废物或浪费
表示突然明白或理解某事
形容容器或空间没有东西
表示什么都没有，含有否定意味
强调完整无缺的，全部的
表示具有重大意义或影响的
指体育运动或娱乐活动

grammar.title: 现在进行时态 (Present Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词-ing + 其他
grammar.definition: 表示正在进行的动作或发生的事态，常与now, at present等时间状语连用 用于描述说话时正在进行的动作，或阶段性正在发生的动作

examples.en: I am fishing now.
examples.zh: 我现在正在钓鱼。

examples.en: She is reading a book at the moment.
examples.zh: 她此刻正在读一本书。

examples.en: They are playing football this afternoon.
examples.zh: 他们今天下午正在踢足球。

grammar.title: 频率副词在句中的位置
grammar.structure: 主语 + 频率副词 + 动词 / 主语 + be动词 + 频率副词 + 其他
grammar.definition: 频率副词（如often, always, never, usually）通常位于行为动词之前，be动词或助动词之后 用于描述动作发生的频率

examples.en: I often fish for hours.
examples.zh: 我经常一钓就是几个小时。

examples.en: I never catch anything.
examples.zh: 我从来什么都抓不到。

examples.en: Some fishermen are unlucky.
examples.zh: 有些钓鱼者运气不好。

grammar.title: but和and的用法区别
grammar.structure: 并列句：句子 + but/and + 句子
grammar.definition: but表示转折对比，and表示顺接或添加 but用于引出与前文相反或出乎意料的内容，and用于连接平行的或顺承的内容

questions.q: Why is fishing the writer's favourite sport?
questions.zh: 为什么钓鱼是作者最喜爱的运动？
questions.a: Because he is not really interested in fishing. He is only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all.
questions.aZh: 因为他对钓鱼本身并不真感兴趣，他感兴趣的只是坐在船上，什么也不做。
questions.hint: 答案在课文最后一句：I'm not really interested in fishing. I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!

questions.q: What do unlucky fishermen catch instead of fish?
questions.zh: 不走运的垂钓者钓上来的不是鱼，而是什么？
questions.a: Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and rubbish.
questions.aZh: 他们没钓到鱼，反倒钓上来旧靴子和垃圾。
questions.hint: 见 Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and rubbish。

questions.q: What do the writer's friends say about fishing?
questions.zh: 作者的朋友们是怎么说钓鱼这件事的？
questions.a: They say, 'You must give up fishing!' and 'It's a waste of time.'
questions.aZh: 他们说：“你可别再钓鱼了！”“这是浪费时间。”
questions.hint: 见 You must give up fishing! 与 It's a waste of time，give up 后须接动名词。

questions.q: How does the writer describe going home after a whole morning on the river?
questions.zh: 作者怎样描述在河上过了整整一上午之后回家？
questions.a: After having spent whole mornings on the river, he always goes home with an empty bag.
questions.aZh: 在河上过了整整一上午之后，他总是带着空袋子回家。
questions.hint: 见 After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag，having spent 表示先发生、已完成。

questions.q: The writer says 'I am even less lucky' although he is talking about catching nothing at all. What does he really mean?
questions.zh: 作者一无所获，却说自己“运气甚至更差”，他真正想表达什么？
questions.a: It is a joke. Those fishermen catch something at least, even if it is only old boots and rubbish, while he catches nothing at all. But he does not worry, because catching fish is not his real interest.
questions.aZh: 这是句玩笑：别人至少还有“收获”，哪怕是旧靴子和垃圾，他却一无所获。但他毫不在意，因为钓鱼根本不是他真正的目的。
questions.hint: 联系 less 的比较级与全文语气：Some fishermen are unlucky… I am even less lucky. I never catch anything — not even old boots。

translation:
钓鱼是我特别喜爱的一项运动。
我经常一钓数小时却一无所获，但我从不为此烦恼。
有些垂钓者就是不走运，他们往往鱼钓不到，却钓上来些旧靴子和垃圾。
我的运气甚至还不及他们。
我什么东西也未钓到过--就连旧靴子也没有。
我总是在河上呆上整整一上午，然后空着袋子回家。
“你可别再钓鱼了！
”我的朋友们说，“这是浪费时间。
”然而他们没有认识到重要的一点，我并不是真的对钓鱼有兴趣，我感兴趣的只是独坐孤舟，无所事事！
title: One man in a boat
subtitle: 独坐孤舟

lead.question: 作者守河钓鱼却常常空手而归，为何仍说钓鱼是最爱的运动？
lead.warmup: 清晨的河面、一根钓竿、几小时的静坐——多数人以收获衡量钓鱼，一个上午空手回家便觉得白费工夫。可本课的作者恰恰相反：他从不为“没钓到”烦恼，不在乎朋友劝他放弃、说这是浪费时间，甚至连“运气不如别人”也说得轻松幽默。读懂他真正的乐趣所在，你就能明白动名词如何把连续的动作压缩成一句紧凑的话。
goals: 复述课文：能用英语讲清作者为何“一无所获”仍最爱钓鱼
掌握 without / instead of / after 后接动名词的造句方式
辨清 after having spent 这类完成式动名词表达的先后顺序
区分 interested 与 interesting，会写 be interested in doing
lead.summary: 本课是第二册动名词的第一课。作者借一连串 -ing 形式自述：without catching anything（一无所获）、instead of catching fish（钓到的不是鱼）、after having spent whole mornings（过了整整一上午之后）、give up fishing、be interested in fishing。规律只有一条：它们都跟在介词或固定搭配之后。抓住 without、instead of、after、in，记住表先后完成用 having + 过去分词，本课语法便拿下。
lead.tips: 易错：instead of 后只能跟名词或动名词，不能接动词原形；单独使用 instead 时才放在句末。

exercises.q: 汉译英：你今天钓到鱼了吗？（用 catch）
exercises.a: Have you caught any fish today?

exercises.q: 填空：I'm not really interested in ______ (fish). I'm only interested in ______ (sit) in a boat and ______ (do) nothing at all.
exercises.note: be interested in 后用动名词。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 instead of 合并两句。They did not catch fish. They caught old boots and rubbish.
exercises.a: Instead of catching fish, they caught old boots and rubbish.
exercises.note: instead of 后接动名词，不接原形。

exercises.q: 改错：After spend whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
exercises.a: After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
exercises.note: 介词后表先发生用 having + 过去分词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：有些垂钓者就是不走运，他们钓上来的不是鱼，而是旧靴子和垃圾。
exercises.a: Some fishermen are unlucky. Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and rubbish.

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 without 合并两句。I often fish for hours. I do not catch anything.
exercises.a: I often fish for hours without catching anything.

exercises.q: 汉译英：朋友们说这是浪费时间，却没有认识到重要的一点。
exercises.a: My friends say it's a waste of time, but they don't realize one important thing.
exercises.note: realize 意识到；a waste of time。

quiz.q: I often fish for hours ______ catching anything. 空格处应填入？
quiz.note: without 作介词，后接动名词。

quiz.q: “Some ______ are unlucky.” 空格的正确形式是？
Instead of ______ fish, they catch old boots and rubbish. 正确形式是？
quiz.note: instead of 是介词短语，后接动名词。

quiz.q: After ______ whole mornings on the river, he goes home with an empty bag. 正确形式是？
quiz.note: 表先于主句发生用 having + 过去分词。

quiz.q: “你可别再钓鱼了！”在课文中的英文表达是？
quiz.note: give up 放弃，后接动名词。

quiz.q: 作者说朋友们没有认识到的重要一点是什么？
options: He wants to catch bigger fish.
He is only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all.
He hopes to sell the old boots.
He enjoys fishing with his friends.
quiz.note: 见课文末句 but they don't realize one important thing。
